name: ctml-skills
description: Agent skills for statistical methods research: simulation studies, supervised learning, readable math, reproducible papers, Overleaf comments, and a tidy LaTeX source layout.

plugins.name: stats-research
plugins.description: Design and report simulation studies, set up and tune supervised learners (including Riesz regression), and write and review the mathematics of LaTeX papers.

plugins.name: paper-pipeline
plugins.description: Keep a code repo and its Overleaf manuscript in step, so every figure, table and inline number is built by the pipeline and stamped with the commit that made it.

plugins.name: overleaf-tools
plugins.description: Work on LaTeX manuscripts that live on Overleaf: read the review comments and tracked changes that the git bridge does not carry, keep each theorem with its proof, and each TikZ figure, in a file of its own, and block reads and edits of a clone that is behind Overleaf.

plugins.name: claude-code-utils
plugins.description: Utilities for Claude Code itself, such as keeping a project's session history when its folder is moved or renamed.
